note: Machine-relative ceilings. Run npm run calibrate:budgets in each enforcement environment; commit worsening only with an explicit recorded trade-off.
statistic: Exact for byte gauges; minimum of repeated samples for timing and DOM-batch gauges.

budgets.rationale: Exact file size after a deterministic build. Asking everywhere deliberately adds editable preset settings, shadow-root visual selection and marks, and atomic docked-note conversion to the live client; the WYSIWYG Quick questions section, linked preset sets, and removable presets are part of that trade. The reader trail (answers beside their source, spring stage, tabs, focus) and exact refresh restore (view-state.js: reader trail, per-document places, card scrolls, PDF places) are part of that trade. Ancestor tabs that lean open under the pointer are part of that trade.

Exact file size after a deterministic build. Asking everywhere deliberately adds read-only visual branch chips, fullscreen selection-safe visual mounting, and preset-origin presentation to frozen snapshots without adding a runtime. Frozen snapshots read through the same reader trail and restore their saved view exactly.
Exact transitive size of app.js and its static chunks; canvas, workspace, model setup, export, math, and PDF runtimes stay outside the landing-page critical path.

budgets.description: DOM mutation batches for a fixed 40-update synthetic stream
budgets.rationale: Minimum observed batch count on an otherwise-quiescent page; 2x ceiling with a 6-batch floor catches loss of rAF coalescing (which produces dozens of batches) without flaking.

budgets.description: Total browser duration for a fixed 40-update synthetic stream
budgets.rationale: Minimum of repeated samples; 3x ceiling absorbs browser scheduling noise.

budgets.description: Elapsed time from final streamed DOM update until the final markdown is persisted
budgets.rationale: Minimum of repeated samples; 2x ceiling with a 100ms floor (poll quantization) still catches a lost flush-on-complete, which costs 400ms+.
